text:
Typical college bar/restaurant.
We ate outside. We tried waiting for the service staff to set up the table with chairs but, after 5 minutes, we did it ourselves. Tables were all dirty with food from other diners...took about 20 minutes to get the dishes taken away. Server finally came to the table and took our order. It took about 40 minutes to see our orders...the soup was cool, the burger had no lettuce/tomato/onion and was over cooked, the ribeye sandwich had meat on 1/2 of it only, and the fries were cold. The ahi salad, club sandwich, and chicken tenders were pretty good.

Overall, not our best experience in Charlottesville for the time and money.
Good food. Good atmosphere. Good service. Not for large groups very narrow restaurant.
Busy Friday UVA game night, super busy but they still provided great and fast service! Food was good.
One of the staples in the Charlottesville area for food and beverage.
This place is an absolute must visit institution in C-ville! The vibe, history and staff make it a favorite place to return to.

Chris the bouncer who had seen me many times before literally grabbed me by my hair as I was walking in and when I walked out and confronted him he cussed me out and was extremely unprofessional and I was deeply hurt by his actions. Management needs to do something about him. I don’t want this to happen to other ladies. Do better.

The dark hair waiter was alerted of the spoiled Ribs & ignored my request to alert the manager.He said they are busy at the bar turned around and gave me his back. Rude and no accountability for selling rotten food specially pork, stale sweet potato fries and the only thing fresh was the Mac & cheese. The restaurant dirty kitchen/bathrooms. We will NEVER RECOMMEND this Restaurant other than STAY AWAY because even the Moscow mule was not done right and served on a clear plastic cup more ice than beverage. This place needs city ordinance to go do an inspection because they will fail in multiple points from our observations. Revoked their license needs to be executed immediately before they get students and others sick with food poisoning etc.
Good food , good prices on the alcohol compared to surrounding places .
Classic college restaurant, good food, good vibes
This is a unique old restaurant on The Corner at UVA. It’s shaped like a long hallway. There’s outdoor seating as well. Service is excellent. I’m happy to report that they now serve Dr. Pepper!

Wanna say firstly service was great. Our server was absolutely on it and everything we needed. However food was just not good at all. Got the Spinach dip and it was basically all cream cheese and like 3 peices of spinach.

Went in for dinner with my father. Vibe was completely classic, was old but well-maintained. Atmosphere was the best part. Drinks were as usual-- coke products and the works-- however beware that if you order a non-refill drink it comes in a smaller glass. Ordered the Virginian Burger and cheesesteak with fries so me and my father could go half & half and get a taste for both. The burger tasted like one you'd get at a family cookout-- not amazing, but not awful-- with no offer of mayo. (We didn't ask though, so that could very well be on us.) The cheesesteak left much to be desired, as there was barely any meat and cheese on thick bread. On a good note, the portion of fries was massive and they were very thoroughly seasoned. Overall, an average meal and experience. The best part was the old charm and the creaks of the place.

Went for the history and reputation, stayed for the atmosphere and service, left happy and with a cool shirt. Great spot, small inside but I went in the summer for lunch/to watch soccer and it was perfect.

Conseguimos assistir o jogo do Brasil no restaurante e comemos bem.
As saladas decepcionaram um pouco. Bem servidas mas com pouco tempero.
Serviço muito atencioso.

Stopped here after a doctors appointment. Looking forward to the French onion soup and food after reading good reviews. Was disappointed.
Rated soup about a 6 due to using strong tasting “garlic?” Croutons used for the toasted bread and Soup wasn’t even close to top rim for $8. Tried the bbq nachos and was pretty good. Husband had steak and cheese sandwich, which he loves other places, and didn’t even eat half here. No taste to beef and small amount of meat on alot of bread. Fries were fresh and seasoned. Limited menu until 5 pm.
Service- our waiter seemed a little overwhelmed. . appetizers and food all came out at same time. Asked for straws 3 times. Dirty plates weren’t bused. Hubby Had to ask for refills and I never got one. Had to wait and flag him down for our check.
Atmosphere- inside seating seems kinda dark and old. kitchen is across from bathrooms with open doorway and was messy with trash/food on floors. We came at 4 pm and only about 4 tables with people there. Waiters seemed to hang at the bar. Very loud at times and hard to converse.
This place has a lot of promise even with its small size and limited seating inside. Outside seating was more spacious but was a little too hot today to sit out. Probably won’t be back.

Stopped in at The Virginian and it’s got that classic local diner feel. Burgers were cooked just right, fries came out hot and crispy, and everything tasted fresh. Service was quick and friendly even with a steady crowd. Nothing over the top, just solid comfort food and a laid-back atmosphere where you can sit back and eat without rushing. Easy spot that feels like it’s been part of the neighborhood forever.
Atmosphere is cool for drinking food is god awful
Great food, service and location. Service was quick. Rib eye cooked very nicely. Would go back again.
This is a fantastic C'ville staple.
Absolutely fantastic burger! I got the one with BBQ sauce. Very filling and the mac and cheese with the potato cake was great, too. I couldn't finish it all but I wanted to!
Food was bland, maybe ok if you're a drunk college student

I came here and I bought a beer and gave her a good tip but  the girl who work in the bar went to the security and told him this guy have to leave I told him why???? She said you are weird I was lone and I was so chill and enjoying the beer but she told to the security this guy have to leave for no reason I mean she’s rude and nasty and me and my friend would never go to this bar till she there
Crab cakes and fried green tomatoes. Both made perfectly. The food here is delicious.
This is your typical downtown college town restaurant. Service is great, food , atmosphere and drinks are great.

I recently went to the Virginian and had a fantastic time. I recommend ordering the club sandwich with sweet potato fries. Personally, I leave off the tomato and get extra mayo on the side. The Virginian is alway delightful, and though the menu is impressive and multi-faceted, I do think the restaurant would benefit from adding a Reuben sandwich to its repertoire. Nonetheless, great drink deals and great service. I was particularly impressed by the host, Samuel, who greeted us with a big smile and made my group feel right at home.
Love love
Amazing service! Just needs a Reuben sandwich
What a place! They would benefit from adding a reuben though.

I've been going to "The Vag" for over 20 years since I first moved to Charlottesville, and I've still never had to enter through the backdoor. I'm always warmly and eagerly welcomed into the rather tight space between the walls of this dimly lit restaurant and bar.

While we did go on the Saturday before St. Patrick’s Day, it was absurdly loud. One might think, oh, it was loud because it’s a college town bar. Wrong. The music was turned up to eleven and management had a policy to keep the music so loud it could be heard outside and it could not be turned down. We asked. It took 45 minutes for our food to be served. Additionally, my steak was cold, I had to ask for a spoon for my soup, and the Caesar salad serving was small, even for a side salad. I paid $30 for a medium rare steak and not only was my steak medium well, it was cold. The only highlight of the night was our waiter, who was very extremely kind and accommodating, despite how packed the place was. You’re wonderful, Carl, and I hope you made bank in tips tonight.

Took an hour to serve a cheese steak. After waiting for so long, we had to go so we asked them to pack to go for us.

While ordering, the price on the menu was less than what they charged us at the end. The waiter repeatedly emphasized how we had to pick two sides with our food, then proceeded to switch up and say that we only get one at the end.

Even after we got our food and paid another extra 1 dollar for their 'service tax', the service was below acceptable. A cheese steak was served with only one of the sides, the side being fresh fruit. They decided to dump the fruit on top of the cheese steak which made the entire bread soggy and the food inedible.

This was a terrible experience. The food was slow, they charged us extra, the menu was misleading and so was the waiter, and this was not worth going to.
Ali is the BEST!! BSE (best service ever). Hands down.

Excellent food large portions ! We had the baby back ribs , steak and cheese sub, chicken tenders for our son , potato soup was amazing, along with the mashed potatoes and gravy and salad as our sides . We will be back very soon! I raced about the food to our server ! 20/10!!!
Great grub!

A long time favorite, both as a student and even decades later. Always make a point to stop by when we are in the area. One of our favorite family traditions. The French onion soup is a particular favorite, and of course the Mac and cheese.
Service was great, food was quick and very good.

This place is a true Cville staple and a big part of what makes UVA feel like UVA, which is why it’s getting four stars instead of three. It’s kind of funny to think about the fact that I ate at the very same table that my friends and I have stood on during a Friday night out. Regardless, the food was solid.

The real highlight—truly excellent—was the mac and cheese!! It was perfectly creamy, and using pepper jack cheese was such a great choice.
CLOSED UNTIL 25TH  FYI
My wife and I had the best club sandwich we've ever had and the French fries were also excellent. The portion size was very generous. Our server Lilly did and outstanding job taking care of us.

Can’t say enough good things about this restaurant! We visited about a month ago after spending the day at Carter’s Mountain, and the food was absolutely incredible. We aren’t from the area, and we accidentally left my son’s favorite water bottle behind. The staff went above and beyond to help us get it back, and they were so kind throughout the process. Amazing food, wonderful people, and an atmosphere that makes you feel right at home! Highly recommend.

My wife and loved how historic it was. Great and cozy. Bartenders are nice and friendly. Food is okay but it wasn't bad.

Would go again!

Stick to the bar food or burgers. Do not order an entree or “signature” plate. Very sad. Worst plate I ever saw— crab cakes. It looked like shoe fly pie and taste was not far from that. We’ve had hundreds.. from Maryland and know these are “Virginia” but not even a real meal. This is closer to a prison loaf. Bourbon Chicken also should be removed from the menu. Cobb salad was great, how can you screw that up? Great service and vibe.
Wonderful place to get together with family and friends. The food was great and had something for all ages. It was a bit loud to visit comfortably.
The famous crab cakes had pin bones in them, so we did not finish our food and had to leave earlier. Please watch out if you get them.

I came here on a whim for Sunday brunch today. It's an historic setting near campus, I suppose - maybe for someone who attended school here. ChatGPT highly recommended it, but the food was tragically underwhelming for the price. The coffee was the plain old weak restaurant variety and my table smelled of sour cleaning cloths. The service was OK, but not at all worth the hype, or the price. There are so many other better options nearby.
Seated pretty quick considering the crowed nature of the place.  Good food and pretty decent service considering the utter chaos for a Saturday night.  Great fried chicken.
The waiter was really kind and chill. The food was excellent and to top it all off, the waiter also played Clash Royale. Automatic 5/5!
Service was awful.  Botched orders badly and took an hour and a half to deliver very subpar food.  You pay for the view only.
Gameday traffic doesn’t slow this place down. Friendly and quick service when it was packed. Grabbed a quesadilla and a Happy Dad. Julia was great behind the bar

We waited 20 minutes before a waiter came over, despite the restaurant being nearly empty. We didn’t receive menus until they finally arrived, and the waiter never introduced themselves.

The food took so long that one of us actually had to leave before it arrived. When they asked for a to-go box, they were bizarrely just handed a bag -- no box, which I’ve never seen before, in my life. The food itself was acceptable, but honestly, I’ve had much better here.

Things only got worse when the check came. We were charged automatic gratuity for a party of five, and the excuse given was, “we always charge auto gratuity if we have to split checks.” On top of that, while some of us were getting cash out, the waiter left with our cards, and we had to chase them down. To finish it off, they didn’t even give us pens to sign the checks.

Overall, a frustrating experience from start to finish. I’m definitely not coming back.

Rootbeer float delicious!!
Burger was great!
Memories wonderful!!!
The team here is great Ian Allison Kate, Kate, Kate, and the other Kate, Judson and Peter all make you feel like part of the family.
The ambiance is fantastic for dining or drinking. It’s lively, loud, and friendly. The food is delicious, and the staff is friendly.
Nice cozy atmosphere
UVA! GO HOOS GO!
Great local UVA spot.
Great bar with slammin food to boot.

Very positive vibes. I came in with 7 others. The staff was super nice and helpful. Service was really quick. The bartenders drinks were on point. A couple of my girls are bartenders and they very much approved.  We all ordered something different and we all gave it a 10..  Thank you to all ✌🏼

Yesterday was our first visit to the Virginian. We were 2 families reuniting after a very long time and we were looking forward to a comfy lunch at a landmark restaurant near the university. I called in advance to see if they could accommodate us. They said no problem. We arrived and were split into two booths. There is absolutely no space that can seat a party larger than 6. Then we discovered that there was a leak above each of these booths- and they were already aware of this!! We relocated now to 3 booths and after placing our orders we learned the system was down which added a delay (beyond their control). The food arrived and it was average at best. In fact I would not recommend the French onion soup. It had an acidic taste. All the while, the server excused himself repeatedly, but the management only offered to comp our beverages- 3 sodas in total! It was only when we complained at the end that they stepped up to the plate with a discount.
These things can happen of course, and it’s unfortunate that they all came together at once. If the server who took my initial call had just indicated that there was no way they could seat us, our crisis could have been averted. Just be forewarned that the establishment is not well maintained and the food is not worth any hype.

Great spot for a mini-pitcher of Natty Light!

The burger is pretty solid as well. Treat yourself to the Mac& cheese.
Everything about this place is amazing!
I’ve been here more times than I can count, and it never disappoints. I always recommend it to anyone visiting UVA because it really captures the positive energy of The Corner.

My steak 'n cheese was delish. We were seated in the far, last table across from the kitchen area. We were constantly rained upon by the condensation from the overhead AC duct...hopefully we won't contract anything.

Dive bar.  Food ok.  Server rushed us from the moment we walked in the door.  They were not that busy either!  Pd. $80 plus tip for 2 burgers and a club sandwich and all had just water to drink.  Not worth it.

This place seems generally charming, however there were some issues today that led me to write this review.

The ac has an issue, causing it to drip water over the booth tables. We moved, but the issue was occurring at both tables.

Additionally, my grandmother and I both ordered the egg plate for brunch, and subsequently we experienced mild food poisoning that we cannot account for with anything else we ate today.

Lastly, it’s very noisy, but that may not bother some!
Went for the institution it is. It's a tiny narrow restaurant. Service is good and food is nice too. We got a hummus platter and some drinks.
Food was really good
Great place! Enjoyed the food.
Always a Corner staple. I've been going here with my family for over 20 years and it never disappoints.
Service is very slow so be sure you have enough time before dining here. But the little outdoor seating is very nice on a sunny day and I really like the food. Prices are good!
They have no respect for Broken Window Serenade or Whiskey Meyers for that matter. They were demanding $50 for a simple song request and were extremely rude. I offered $20…

Sat outside at the Virginian. The wait staff were great and friendly even though it was packed on a Saturday night. The food was delicious and the atmosphere was what you would expect from a busy college area. We showed up at 5 pm and got our food around 550pm. So if you go on a busy nights, just be prepared to wait till you eat.

Always delicious! I've been going here with my family for the last 20+ years and it is always fun, delicious and a great time. The BBQ Chicken Salad is delicious and you can't beat the Coalminer sandwich.
Crew was nice, food was depressing average but still a good little dive to find. Markers Mark sauce was nice, especially served on the spiced apples.
Historic restaurant with a cool vibe,  great young wait staff, and delicious food. Must eat here when visiting UVA/CVL!

We really enjoyed our visit to Charlottesville and our stop at The Virginian. The food was a highlight of the trip! The barbecue pork sandwich was excellent, as were both the Caesar and house salads—fresh and flavorful. The Virginia burger with fries was also very good.

We were excited to try the Palmetto cheese burger and the Palmetto cheese sandwich, but unfortunately, they didn’t quite meet our expectations. They weren’t our favorites. The seasoned fries got mixed reviews—some of us enjoyed the bold flavor, while others found them a bit too spicy.

The root beer floats were a big hit—absolutely delicious! The atmosphere was lively and welcoming, which made the overall experience even better.
Great place to eat and drink!

Were there on a week day for procedure at the hospital, and wanted walking distance quick lunch. Several people greeted us as they rushed past with full arms and didn't leave us just waiting. Super nice staff, mostly young college kids. Not a lot of seating but great food, quick staff, and not over priced. Will stop in after our next visit!
Good songs, good food, good service. They try hard to understand your language and are understanding. The food is very filling and delicious. It's welcoming.

Hmmm… what can I say? The only reason we gave this place a shot was because it’s open until 1 AM. But by 10 PM, they had already turned off all the table lights—even though only two tables were occupied. Subtle hint to leave?

As for the food, everything we ordered was just okay—nothing memorable. The daily specials were interesting enough to try, but overall, it definitely feels like a spot geared toward college students. On the bright side, our server put in the effort and provided good service. Props to him!
Food was delicious!  Best service we’ve had in a long time!

A corner tradition! The burger is had brought back amazing memories from my college days. The staff was efficient. I remember back in my college days having bartenders that engaged their customers discussing life, UVA, and the corner. I miss the days of Coy Barefoot for sure.
Historic restaurant and bar.  A staple on the corner in Charlottesville.

Still very reminiscent of a bar and restaurant founded in the early 1900’s. The atmosphere was very good. Has an upper and lower level. The food is amazing!  Great choices. Our food came out hot, fast, and correct. Service at first was very good. It tapered off after our food was served. There are a few TV’s, but not considered a sports bar. Price was reasonable at about $30 a person. We did not partake in any drink specials.  Dinner menu starts at 5PM.
Not a bad little place for a college town.  Great if you like the bar atmosphere.

Whenever I come to the Virginian, I know I am in for a good time. I have come in the morning with my family for brunch, in the afternoon for a beer, and in the evening to stand on a booth and dance.
Today was no different. Because of the snow day, I came in with my friends to hangout and enjoy the afternoon. My server, Emily, could not have been more warm and inviting. I am so thankful I have found this place. I understand why it has been around for 100 years.

I ordered soup for takeout last week, which tasted fine. The problem was they charged me for a tip, which I did not authorize. Handing over a bowl of soup in a plastic bag doesn't warrant a tip for service. Adding a charge that a customer has not authorized, in contrast, constitutes petty theft.
Hubby has club sandwich & potato soup. I had steak & cheese sandwich & onion soup on the side. They are all good! Highly recommended⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Came to town for a concert and stopped in for dinner beforehand. Chuck took great care of us.

Told at 1:15 pm that I could not order lunch only the brunch items, I sat at the bar for 30 mins before I was told I couldn’t order lunch! I ordered a club sandwich, and when denied I left a 20$ on the bar for my 1 beer and had the bartender(tress) run outside and tell me I hadn’t cashed out. She didn’t bother to tell me all I could order was eggs and didn’t like a 13$ cash tip. Enjoy children servicing you
Mac and cheese is unmatched. Ribs were super-tender. My wife scarfed my club sandwich leftovers 😡😂

I ordered a burger here, and it was great, and so were the fries.  The waiter was really nice, and the food arrived much faster than I expected.  There's also two TVs, and most places inside you can watch at least one.
Great service great drinks and great vibes! Highly recommended
Good bar. Great staff, good food and an interesting tap list. TWO stouts on offer right now
We had an amazing server named seff and the food was great.
Was on my to do list on my visit back home.  I like that it's never changed.  Here's to another hundred years!
Great atmosphere, friendly staff (student run establishment?) if you want bar food, this is the place to be. Great draft selections

We visited on a Monday night around 6:30pm. We were sat almost immediately and given prompt drink service. Our food arrived pretty swiftly after as well. The food was great, and the portions were generous.

My only demerit for the service was that after we paid our check, our waitress never returned with the box I had requested. We waited for several minutes, and eventually I grabbed my own box.
I had the crab cakes but the appearance and the texture seemed more like burger style than crab cakes 😔
Food was luke warm to cold. Nothing but a beer joint selling food.

We were eating our food and a ROACH was on the table! We caught it in a napkin and dropped on the floor to kill it. The waitress didn't care at all, she said the manager would call the exterminator.  We immediately stopped eating! We were charged full price.
Food was good. Waitresses were awesome. Not a wide variety of food though. Very busy area with little free parking.
Food was very good. Sat outside on the patio which was a really nice spot with green space right across the street. Service was good and prices were reasonable.
Oldest restaurant in Virginia.  Small place in a college town.  Burgers are flame-broiled.  Delicious

The pimento cheese sandwich is unreal and the fries are always perfectly seasoned. Wonderful environment and drinks– an iconic place for sure! I went a lot over the summer before moving across the country and I miss it!
One of our favorite places when we visit UVA.  Great food, good portions, and a good price. It has a very college-like atmosphere, lots of students, a few parents.  Sports on TV.

The food was good.  I wanted a chocolate alcoholic drink and the bar lady made me the best drink ever. The staff was friendly and I will go back. The main reason for going there is because they open late at night.
Great local place that's been here for 101 years! Good food, full bar and the nicest staff make this a fun, casual place worth coming back to.
Food is mediocre, prices are high . Mac and cheese was horrible could see kitchen staff pick up cooked  food with bare hands
Excellent service! Great food and attentive staff!
Had a great dinner here with my family. The food was excellent and everyone was raving about it. I would certainly recommend it for casual dining and quality food.
Oldest restaurant!   Right in historic downtown. Great atmosphere, service and food.
I loved this restaurant. The history, food and service were “awesome.” ;) Definitely recommend
It was just fine. Didn't impress and wasn't anything unique or special.
Great and historic spot for a quick meal day or night. Never had a bad meal there. It’s the corner so parking isn’t easy, so plan ahead.
First time here.  One of the smallest places I have been in.  Would go go back

Exactly what you hope to find close to a university campus. Great staff and service. A charming experience that feels like it’s been the same for decades or a century. Interesting drink menu. Good for families. The food was good too!

Food is always decent, the mac and cheese is a winner every time! Wait staff is sometimes short with you but it's a small space so they're just trying to clear tables quickly. A nice nostalgic spot even the pickiest eaters would enjoy!
American fare, decent prices
Great little place. Good food, good atmosphere.

My sister and I were in town for a one-night getaway!  We were ravenous after a long, enjoyable but tiring day and had been searching for over an hour for a good place for dinner when my sister, fortunately, finally grabbed the first street parking space she saw. We ended up right in front of The Virginian - lucky us!  We sat across from each other in a delightful wooden booth, tasted an excellent Classic Gimlet and then devoured our perfectly cooked half-pound burgers with everything-fresh salads.  All of this was enhanced by outstanding service (thank you, Terri!) and the warm, cozy atmosphere in such a historic place. We will be back!
Wow - great food at a reasonable price. The wait staff is very friendly.
Food was really good, staff were friendly, lots of choices of beers, ciders, and IPA's.
Do this!!!!
Great place for a bite. Friendly staff great food. Great location to go if you’re between appointments at the hospital. Took me about 10 minutes to walk there
honestly service was a little slow but the staff was friendly. i think the employees are pretty much all students so its a very chill vibe. pulled pork sandwich was really good :)
Great desserts!
very friendly staff, good food and the best place for a break, close to the UVA
Food was good, service good, a very lively place...loved the atmosphere!

Looked this local place up for a stop after a hospital visit , hungry as heck , this place did not disappoint. Very quaint , but buzzing with college kids . The food was very good , the service was excellent. It's nice to find young people with manners . I had the apple bourbon glazed chicken & my wife had the crab cake sandwich.  We also both had a bowl of French onion soup. Totally enjoyed it all.

Si merita 5 stelle su tutti i fronti, aggiungo che sono veloci nel servizio. L'ambiente è super.
Molto vicino all'università è frequentato da studenti.
Ottimo rapporto prezzo qualità
Got the Virginian club sandwich and it was okay. The ceaser salad was also okay. Nothing special.
Great service from our waiter and the food was good! Was driving through while going to local attractions in town and we saw it.
Service was good! Mac and cheese was great; definitely a must get! The other food was decent.
Been the same for over 30 years and that's what makes it great
The food is just mediocre at best. Chicken tenders had a ridiculous amount of breading and fries are seasoned, which should be made obvious on the menu. Service was good.

Not only is this place historical, it has a great reputation for having friendly staff and great food. Highly recommend!

I sat at the bar. The bartender could not have been nicer! I did not love my drink, but that’s because it was too sweet for me. She let me mix it with some soda water and it was good.

The club sandwich was simple and good. The main event was the Mac n cheese.

Let me just say whoever decided to put a potato cake on top of Mac n cheese is a GENIUS. I’ll be dreaming about it until I have it again.

Perfect little date night! My wife and I came here after numerous recommendations and I cannot be happier with my experience. The food was incredible and our Waitress, Torie, was outstanding. We spoke to the manager as well and she had such a great attitude towards us and everyone in here. I cannot wait to come back!
Food was great, quick turn around-time. Friendly advice about UVA as our waitress was an undergraduate student.
Food was sub par.  I ordered the chicken breast, but it was cut into chunks and drowning in BBQ sauce.
Always a great stop for lunch or dinner.
Great food and service. Somewhat crowded space. Overall it was a pleasant experience.
100 years old! And the whiskey hasn't run out yet! Buy a T-shirt while you're there! Great burgers, See you next time I'm in C'vill!
Best club sandwich.  Brunch is perfect.  Have to go here if UVA alum, parent, student.

Visited here with my son who is a student at UVA
Food was pretty good, but the service and atmosphere was fantastic.
I recommend the Mac and cheese
Went there late night for a couple beers with a friend. The bartenders and patrons were all friendly 😌

Server had the wrong item on my order. When I told him so, he called his superior who tried to stare me down instead of listening. When I explained, they haphazardly removed the item and replaced it with my side. I could still see the leftovers on my plate.
My favorite bar in Charlottesville!
Horrible environment inside
The sweet potato fries were amazing, but the wrap they came with was just ok.  The service was poor, and the space felt dirty and sticky.

Been meaning to stop in for many years, but just never got around to it. I'm glad I finally did. Tried a sandwich I've considered many times at many establishments, but did not. The Chicken Philly. Onions, peppers, chicken, nice sub roll and voila, loved it. Seasoned fries, excellent ranch dipping sauce. The vibe of the place is perfect if you remember that little neighborhood joint that always felt comfortable. I don't live in or near Charlottesville, but I will make it a point to visit again.
Wonderful location, Great service!  Love the students!  Unforunate barley edible food. As someone said like a cafeteria, soggy fries and so on. Please upgrade your chefs and your menu.

Took a really long time to get food. The place wasn't very busy but still took a while even though I only ordered one burger. However, the atmosphere and overall aesthetics of the place was fantastic, and the food was good. If you have the time definitely check it out!
The garden salad was good, but no tomatoes.  Loved the chicken tenders, so crunchy! The fries were well seasoned as well. A good place for a tasty lunch.

The food is not good. The coleslaw teasted greasy. And the brownie teasted old.
Need more cleaning in the kitchen and in the resrtooms.

This is an old establishment but it doesn't have to be rundown looking the way it is. The bathroom was filthy and the restaurant was very dirty. The margarita tasted like there's absolutely no tequila in it. We got the ribs which tasted like cafeteria food. The club sandwich was just edible but the French fries were extremely old and cold. We were very disappointed because this restaurant is of lower quality than it's rating. Quite disappointing because we like to go to historic restaurants.
The Mac with the potatoe OMG !!!!!
Mac and cheese and onion soup were great!!! I had crab cake sandwich but it was 그냥 그랬음 ㅋㅋ.

Why buy a fast food burger at Five Guys when you can have a sit down burger at a lower price with fries! This isn't your typical bar food, it's very good.

The night life is also amazing. Come for dinner and stay for the party until 2am every night.
The service was pretty good. The food was sub par.

Had to eat somewhere and stumbled in. Read some reviews and took a risk: burger with mushroom , steak and cheese sandwich and sweet potato fries. Sweet potato fries were amazing! Picked them because one of the reviews. Burger was excellent and I rarely eat burgers because they’re usually too soggy, overcooked or boring. This one was good! Steak in the steak and cheese was good but not remarkable. Coleslaw had a bit much mayo. Spring gimlet was great! Overall very good food, very much college food but a good choice. I missed taking a pic of the sweet potato fries but do try them.
I believe our servers name was Seth, we came in on 09/13 night and he served us outside. Awesome server and great food!
Good service. Ordered a philly and coleslaw. Small and extremely mediocre.

Bryn was engaging.... especially with giving advice to our 1st year. ☺️. She offered to do an app with the Pimento Cheese as a dip and brought to-go boxes asap.  We ordered a crabcake sandwich (amazing), Chipotle chicken wrap (5/5), and a club sandwich (HUGE... but a typical club).  The Mimosa and Spicy Ranch Water were delicious!  Atmosphere was super cute.
The food and service was great!
a classic!
Went here for one of our last meals before moving out of state. It was good, but very average food this trip.
Cool historical bar. Worth the visit!

Went there for dinner. No server for 10 minutes then had to ask for one. Then got water and ordered. After 25 minutes more, drinks weren’t even served.
Got up and left.
Terrible service
Great selection of  beers.

Hip, cozy college eatery across from UVA that just happens to be the oldest restaurant in Chancellorsville. Basic pub menu with daily specials that include wraps, salads and fish & chips. Be prepared for a wait, especially around lunch.
Loved it!

I usually don't post reviews but money is tight for some right now and the food...chicken filly,hamburger and spinach dip was terrible, the chicken wasn't even warm and the peppers and onions not cooked 😞 and the Margarita was the worst I have ever drank 😞
Great selection of beer.
Brunch was amazing! The breakfast sandwich was buttery and delicious! 10/10 highly recommend

This was great! The food wasn’t anything super super special, but the atmosphere and service were great. It felt old-timey in a perfect way, and our waiter was incredibly friendly. Great spot for right after our UVA tour.
A perfect local spot for a drink.  Great service, great vibe.  Food is hot or miss but worth it for the vibe alone.
Food was excellent, service was warm and friendly. We were being tourists and the restaurant didn't disappoint.
Wait staff was friendly and accomadating, we were a group of 7. Very relaxed during summer break for UVA. Go now and order the mac and cheese.
Service is absolutely atrocious. They never come back with drink refils. Food is ok.

They food is very good, and the atmosphere may leave you a little claustrophobic during the lunch rush. Food comes out at a reasonable time. I rate this a little lower due to watching the bar tender sneezing on clean glasses and not rehashing them.

We ended up waiting over an hour and a half in total to be seated and to receive our food! Food was ok but definitely not worth that wait time. I assume the wait staff knew our wait would be long but wouldn't give us an estimated time. Had I known we would be waiting that long, we would've eaten elsewhere.

To die for Mac-n-Cheese!!! That potato cake on top of those twisty, curly cheesy noodles…I can’t even tell you how amazing it tastes when it touches your tongue. Don’t go for the side dish size, go for the entree one! Ok, I did the side dish size with the fried chicken, mashed potatoes and gravy because I didn’t know I should have ordered the entree size of those decadent noodles. Don’t make the same mistake! 😊

However, the chicken, mashed potatoes and gravy were very good. We also had their Virginian burger with added bacon and a side of fries. Great fresh burger cooked a perfect medium.

You do feel like you are going back in time while dining in the close quarters. Look at the pictures on the wall so you can image yourself there in the 20’s with a group of friends or family.

If Allison is still there serving, she does an amazing job! Say “Hi” to her for us! And tip her well! 😉
Good food, cool setting, and decor. The music is a little loud, but great choices. Their mac and cheese was wonderful.
The best burgers! Great service! It is a nice place, ambiance is what it is, a pub. Not romantic dinner. Did I mention the food was awesome!!

The wait for our drinks and food was long. I heard the waitresses telling other patrons that they were overwhelmed. I was extremely disappointed with the fried chicken. It was overcooked yet barely warm when I received it. There was also some sort of potato pattie that was  overcooked.  The macaroni and cheese and coleslaw were good.

Ya’ll going to love this place “For sure.”. It is what it is, and it’s good at that, so it gets 5 stars. If you’re looking for fine dining then pass on by, but if you want to feel, smell and taste the flavors of a college joint and Charlottesville then stop and enjoy the experience. We were in Charlottesville for just one night to visit Montecello and checked in early evening. We needed to refuel before we went to bed and headed out in the morning. Didn’t want anything fancy, just good food at a good price. I was checking out all the little cards you find in the hotel lobby with my fellow travelers and came across one for “ The Virginian”. It
looked appealing and interesting so I checked it out online. Everyone agreed it
looked good so we took a chance and went out to find it. It was only a few minutes away which was also a reason we picked it.

It is located right across the street from the University of Virginia in an area referred to as “The Corner”. It has been there since the 1920’s and it looks and feels like it. That’s the type of place I enjoy, venues with history and atmosphere. What the heck, if it’s been around for 100 years they must be doing something right. It is a long narrow joint with a bar and several booths. There’s even one cool booth in the front window that is shaped in an unconventional figuration because of the space , so it fits right into the area. The wood is dark and old like you would expect in a 100 year old joint. It’s a college watering hole but was pretty quite because the spring semester was over. Collectively the ages of all the kids dining and working probably didn’t add up to our
foursome of late 60’s and early 70 year
olds. 😂
We we’re greeted by “Jack” who turned out to be our waiter as well. Jack greeted us with a few “Ya’ll’s” so I asked him where he was from and he said San Francisco. We had a good laugh over that. Jack was a very personable and engaging young man. He is an incoming freshman at UVA and is starting early this summer. It didn’t take him long to acquire a nice smooth Virginia accent. He loved our Boston accents and we hit it
off right away. He candidly admitted to us this was his first shift of waiting by himself with out assistance. He faired very well and I think he’ll catch one and be a valued employee. There were a few small things that need correcting with our order and he was quick and accommodating.
Our food was well prepared, delicious and hot. Our items varied from a garden salad with grilled chicken to a pulled pork sandwich to a BLT. There were generous portions, fresh ingredients and brought to us quickly. Needless to say there are dozens of beers to choose from as well.

So if you find yourself in the area of
“The Corner” in Charlottesville and even if you’re well past the age of a college freshman, do yourself a favor and stop by “The Virginian” for great food, great beverages and great service. You’ll be glad you did.
Historic location with a no-frills menu and simple beer list. Service was uninterested. Worth a stop just to see, but definitely could pick up their game.
Delicious crab cakes!
Good service good food
There was a roach in the bathroom.
Great happy hour till 7pm.
Nice littlw hole in the wall that's been around since I can remember. Daytime food and late night menu also tasy might I add.
Really enjoyed lunch here. Delicious crab cake, fries, and coleslaw. Also had a great margarita and enjoyed friendly and quick service. Can't wait to come back and try more things on the menu.
General pub food.

Stopped here for a late lunch. Food was really delicious and good portions. I had a chicken wrap, and my friend had a Virginian Club. It was huge.  Fries were also good.  Parking is your only issue but that is the case in most downtown areas. We would go back.
Food delicious, service poor, restrooms cleanliness bad.

Took about 5 minutes to get a table with no one in front of me. Had a burger which was fine but the fries were made for composting and not actually eating them. I don’t think people come here for the food, as the establishment (now 100 years old) seems to have a lot of history behind it. In that sense it was pretty cool to eat there.

Incredible burger for me, everyone loved the chicken fingers and it was a great value in an environment that can’t be beat.  Really felt historic and welcoming to all groups.  Perfect mix of fun and class.
The house home fries served with brunch are one of the best things I've ever tasted!

Food not worth the price. Spent 60 plus tip on a small steak/cheese sandwich(and I do mean small; no lettuce, tomatoes or any other toppings; just steak, cheese and a few onions 😔) and a burger and a drink. They severely undercooked burger and it had to sent back. I only give 2 stars because the waitress did provide decent service.
Stopped in for some lunch. Great service and good grub.
